films.title: 3 Weeks After
films.synopsis: When a school trip leaves a group of teenagers stranded far from home, the recent suicide of a classmate begins to expose the fractures, loyalties and secrets holding them together.

films.title: 5 More Minutes
films.synopsis: An on-the-rocks couple retreat to a secluded countryside home for the weekend in an effort to repair their marriage. They're greeted by the singular head of the real estate agency who shows them around the place and hands over the keys. Just before he leaves, however, the entire world slips into a time loop, and the last five minutes begin to repeat endlessly.

films.title: Adult Supervision
films.synopsis: Three fathers accompany their teenage daughters on a school trip to a remote island. What begins as a peaceful getaway soon turns into a series of unexpected problems. Each father has a different approach to parenting, influenced by his own past experiences, and their conflicting views create tension among them. As the situation becomes increasingly difficult to control, memories of their past return and force them to confront their mistakes and shortcomings. The trip ultimately leaves them questioning who is really in control.

films.title: Attack on Paradise
films.synopsis: After seven sleepless years, Suleyman reunites with his mother just as henchmen, cops and a bad raid drag him back into violence.

films.title: Beware Boiúna
films.synopsis: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

films.title: The Birthday Party
films.synopsis: Nora turns 40 and gets three uninvited guests who insist she isn't who she claims — and her constructed life comes apart.

films.title: The Blood Countess
films.synopsis: The Blood Countess and her maid embark on a quest for the red elixir of life and a book that threatens the vampire realm. Hot on their heels are a police inspector, two vampirologists, a vegetarian nephew and his therapist.

films.title: Blood Feast
films.synopsis: In the sleepy suburbs of Miami, seemingly normal Egyptian immigrant Fuad Ramses runs a successful catering business. He also murders young women and plans to use their body parts to revive the goddess Ishtar. The insane Ramses hypnotizes a socialite in order to land a job catering a party for her debutante daughter, Suzette Fremont, and turns the event into an evening of gruesome deaths, bloody dismemberment and ritual sacrifice.

films.title: Bloody Tennis
films.synopsis: Sophie joins a prestigious tennis academy, where the brutality of competitive sports is taken to its extreme and only the hungriest survive.

films.title: Carrie (two episodes)
films.synopsis: Carrie navigates a viral bullying scandal and emerging telekinesis after her father's death.

films.title: Cinema Recomposed: Silent Monsters
films.synopsis: A live string quartet performs new scores by seven composers aged 17–24 for seven classic silent horror shorts.

films.title: Compliance
films.synopsis: On the eve of a landmark deal for a major tech startup, they're faced with a sexual assault controversy that threatens to become a PR disaster. As new hire Sam works to contain the fallout, it becomes clear that not all is as it seems, and she quickly finds herself in a game of cat and mouse with a criminal organization taking aim at the company and their investors.

films.title: Corpus
tags: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
films.synopsis: It’s the summer of 1998 in New York City; Sayo, a soulful nightlife photographer and small-time drug dealer, is invited to a party upstate by his longtime friend and unrequited love, a movie star on the rise: Vince Marlowe. Together with their rowdy friend Ross, they drive to a remote, bucolic manor in hopes of some summer debauchery. But when they arrive, they discover that the promise of a party is actually three mysterious women — Billie, Wren, and Cata — whose disturbing agenda draws the boys into a dark web of seduction and terror.

films.title: The Cycle
films.synopsis: A man missing 36 years turns up at a crime scene; his estranged daughter unpicks his past.

films.title: Death Has No Master
films.synopsis: Caro travels to Venezuela to sell her late father’s cacao plantation, only to find the family mansion occupied by its former staff, who are determined to remain at all costs. As Caro takes justice into her own hands to claim the inheritance she believes is hers, she sets off a struggle that unearths the violence buried in the land and its memory.

films.title: Death of a Yellow Bird
films.synopsis: A dying man who returns to his childhood home to record a series of messages for his son. But what begins as an attempt to leave something behind takes a supernatural turn when he discovers a presence haunting the isolated cabin.

films.title: Dog God
films.synopsis: Banned in Thailand for nearly 30 years for insulting religion; an anarchic attack on blind faith.

films.title: Donkey Princess
films.synopsis: Diana is the princess of an ancient kingdom. Her father, King Arthur, forbids love. When Diana falls in love with Lalo, he banishes him. Using a magical bracelet, Diana travels to other worlds in search of her love.

films.title: Extreme Prejudice
films.synopsis: Lean, mean Texas Ranger Jack Benteen locks horns with a former friend, Cash Bailey, now a ruthless drug kingpin. Though they're on opposite sides of the law, they share a love interest in the sensual Sarita. When a crew of rogue soldiers descends upon the border town for an off-the-books mission, all roads lead to a bloody, to-the-death showdown, as loyalties shift and the lines between good and evil are blurred.

films.title: The Face of Horror
films.synopsis: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

keyword: based on myths, legends or folklore

films.title: Flapjax
films.synopsis: An over-eager fast-food manager is tasked with reviving a highly addictive menu item called "FLAPJAX" to save his fast-food company from bankruptcy. He pulls his estranged mother, a faded pop-star known as Popo, out of retirement to promote the item. However, he soon becomes ensnared by the company's true intentions and his deeply rooted mommy issues.

films.title: Frisk
films.synopsis: A first person narrative of the exploits of a gay serial killer in deeply disturbing, controversial drama about violence, sexuality, and the imagination. Dennis, the main character, whose lead we follow on this path between what is real and what we can only hope is surreal. His friends attempt to determine if he's truly a psychopath.

films.title: Full Phil
films.synopsis: Wealthy American industrialist Philip Doom attempts to reconnect with his daughter Madeleine during a luxurious trip to Paris. Unfortunately, French cuisine, a 1950s horror film, and an intrusive hotel employee disrupt their stay.

films.title: Future Tense
films.synopsis: In a dystopian future, a young couple clashes during their time-traveling vacation.

films.title: Game Master
films.synopsis: A warm comedy about imagination, awkward parenthood and the eccentric world of live-action roleplay.

films.title: Ghost in the Cell
films.synopsis: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.

films.title: Gimme Truth
films.synopsis: False flags. Forbidden archeology. Chemtrails. Nefarious extraterrestrials. Fake pandemics. Through the intertwined stories of truth-seekers, influencers, and ex-believers, the film explores what draws people into the gravitational pull of conspiracy culture, and what happens when your truth becomes your identity.

films.title: Girl in the Night
films.synopsis: The aimless life of an alienated petty thief takes an unexpected turn for the worse when he steals a bicycle from an enigmatic girl who spends her nights fighting crime.

films.title: The Glorious Dead
films.synopsis: A small-town sheriff and her deputy awaken to a changed world where blood drips from taps, people and pets vanish, fleshy creatures roam the woods, and the hamlet descends into chaos. By noon, the skies turn white with snow, and the dirt cannot keep the dead down as the shattered community buckles under the pressure, and as the sun sets, all hell has frozen over.

films.title: Godmother
films.synopsis: A meticulously planned desert couples' vacation spirals into chaos when family tensions and a pair of mysterious hosts with devilish intentions transform a romantic getaway into a nightmare.

films.title: Half
films.synopsis: Two half-vampire siblings, left for dead by scavengers, come back for revenge.

films.title: Hell House
films.synopsis: A look at the "Hell House" performed annually in October by the youth members of Trinity Church (Assemblies of God) in Cedar Hill, Texas (a Dallas suburb) — seen by over 10,000 visitors each year.

films.title: Henry: Portrait of a Serial Killer
films.synopsis: Arriving in Chicago, Henry moves in with ex-con acquaintance Otis and starts schooling him in the ways of the serial killer.

films.title: The Heretiks
films.synopsis: On Halloween night, a disaffected teenage girl must team up with a renegade witch to protect her little sister from a murderous coven hellbent on sacrificing her in an apocalyptic ritual.

films.title: I Have Proof
films.synopsis: Plot details are being kept locked in an old VCR, but the film is said to be psychologically charged, and favor 'texture, imperfection, and immediacy over polish'.

films.title: Into the Sky
films.synopsis: A man's efforts to win back his wife keep getting derailed when aliens mysteriously snatch him from Earth, making his path to reconciliation a lot more complicated than expected.

films.title: Janur Ireng: Sewu Dino the Prequel
films.synopsis: After losing their family home in a devastating fire, two impoverished siblings accept the hospitality of a wealthy long-lost uncle, unaware that his grand estate holds a sinister plot to exploit them.

films.title: Jim Queen
films.synopsis: When Heterosis - a mysterious virus that turns gay men straight sweeps through the Parisian gay scene, Jim, the six packed sovereign of the Gym Queens, goes from Pride royalty to social outcast. With only Lucien, a freshly-out twink with more heart than abs, still by his side, Jim must race to find a cure before the disease erases the community that once worshipped him.

films.title: Jollyface
films.synopsis: A woman investigating her Black fiancé's murder is hunted through her apartment complex by a killer silencing the truth.

films.title: Kick On
films.synopsis: When a night of partying leads four friends to kick on, at the extravagant drug-fueled lair of a mobster's reckless son, they find themselves fighting for their lives amidst a brutal spiral of paranoia, violence and ultimate betrayal.

films.title: Kung Fu Deadly
films.synopsis: Danny and Frank, two bumbling pest exterminators, cross paths with the enigmatic Lien, a Taoist guardian hunting an ancient Chinese jiangshi in Dublin. Together they set out to deal with this menace the only way they know how: extermination.

films.title: Kylgor in the Grisly Abyss
films.synopsis: Kylgor and his band of fellow survivors set out for revenge and to behead the Evil King Kath but unexpectedly plummet into the Grisly Abyss.

films.title: Little Doors
films.synopsis: In a quietly apocalyptic world a lonely woman discovers a small wooden door on the side of her body and must decide whether or not to open it.

films.title: Magick Mtn.
films.synopsis: Lord Mmorke, a tepid and ghoulish narrator, walks us through 3 separate fables all intersecting in a realm beyond the tangible. Rituals and retellings about a Deathrock squatter jailed by a sadistic psychiatrist and the evils of regret, a pair of criminal plumbers plunging further towards Hell's grips and the beer-soaked leather of the Sunset Strip, and an architect's ambition built on the shaky bedrock of the Devil's promise. What begins as a tale ends in a spell cast upon unsuspecting characters and audiences alike

films.title: Mr. Creamjeans' Hidey Hole
films.synopsis: Henry, a man plagued by chronic pain and unresolved guilt, receives a chilling message: "I know what you did." The note leads him to The Hidey Hole, an underground museum of erotic nightmares, curated by the charismatic and unsettling Mr. Creamjeans. There, Henry is offered a chance to erase all traces of his secret crime... but only if he submits to a guided tour of the museum's most depraved exhibits. With every tale, Henry's pain worsens and his grip on reality slips, until he's forced to confront the twisted role he's played in the lives (and deaths) of others. By the end, Henry must decide: confess the truth and face the consequence, or lose himself to the Hidey Hole forever.

films.title: No Rest for the Wicked
films.synopsis: 1862. Baldur lives a fisherman’s life on the isolated Faroe Islands far to the north in the Atlantic Ocean. His world is turned upside down when a stranger arrives: Helge, a rugged whaler, who awakens deep emotions within him. A mutual attraction starts to grow. When tragedy strikes, their forbidden passion unleashes natural forces so disturbing that the villagers rally to keep evil at bay. But Baldur and Helge refuse to let their love be buried. They will fight till the end – and after.

films.title: No Way Down
films.synopsis: An ex-convict enters a derelict tower block to find his ex-girlfriend's brother and is pulled back into violence.

films.title: Ogroff
films.synopsis: Ogroff, an AWOL-solider-turned-hermit, lives in the French backwoods, and, still believing war to be raging, slaughters anyone who enters them. One day, a family's car breaks down in Ogroff's domain and a fight for their lives begins.

films.title: The Ones Who Grieve
films.synopsis: At the end of the 19th century, on an isolated farm, Zélie is trapped under the authority of her father, Jacob, a deeply religious man. As a mysterious disease known as the “Black Veil” ravages the surrounding countryside and faith begins to blur with madness, she must fight to preserve her humanity and claim her freedom.

films.title: Pathetic Fallacy
films.synopsis: A young widower arrives in a new-age mountain town in search of cosmic answers and a chance to heal. Instead, he finds an outlandish murderer and a forest of demonic spirits who offer a horrific bargain: the power to cheat death at a nightmarish cost.

films.title: Phreaker
films.synopsis: Inspired by true events. Before there were hackers, there were phreakers. A blind teenager joins the early underworld of "phone freaks" where he learns to hack his way to money, power, and eventually, a place on the FBI's most wanted list.

films.title: Platypus
films.synopsis: Kimberly, a young schoolgirl in a small town, secretly dreams of the masked killer Platypus terrorizing the area. But nobody believes her, and the dreams are becoming more vivid, more violent, and ever closer to home.

films.title: Play House
films.synopsis: While renovating a dilapidated house to win back his ex, a young man discovers VHS tapes of an unaired TV show in the basement. But as the show’s dark history surfaces, it seeps into his life, threatening his last chance at reconciliation.

films.title: Posthumous
films.synopsis: After returning to her childhood home, Zoe discovers a mysterious videotape that unravels everything she thought she knew about her birth and her mother's death, awakening an unimaginable horror.

films.title: A Prayer for the Dying
films.synopsis: In 1870 Friendship, Wisconsin, a small town of Scandinavian settlers still suffering the repercussions of the recent Civil War. When faced with a new and even deadlier threat, one man is forced to make a harrowing choice: save his young family or defend the community that gave him a second chance at life and meaning.

films.title: Red Snow
films.synopsis: In Finland, sixteen-year-old emo teen Johanna dreams of a glittering Twilight vampire prince. What she gets instead is Martti — a balding, beer-bellied 49-year-old bloodsucker who slips into a Santa suit to gain entry to homes and devour entire families. In Finland, sixteen-year-old emo teen Johanna dreams of a glittering Twilight vampire prince. What she gets instead is Martti — a balding, beer-bellied 49-year-old bloodsucker who slips into a Santa suit to gain entry to homes and devour entire families. When Johanna crosses paths with Martti on Christmas Eve, she thinks her dark fairy tale has come true. But instead of eternal romance, she finds herself trapped in a bloody and horrific nightmare of aging masculine toxicity, family trauma, and festive slaughter. By morning, the snow will turn red.

films.title: Resident Evil
films.synopsis: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

films.title: River
films.synopsis: Three estranged siblings scattering their father's ashes are stranded on a river and hunted by a masked stranger.

films.title: Roma Elastica
films.synopsis: 1982. French actress Eddie is on the verge of collapse and travels to Rome accompanied by her loyal makeup artist, Valentina, to shoot a science-fiction film – a film that could be her last one.

films.title: Roy from Space
films.synopsis: In this unauthorized adaptation of the first two Flash Gordon story arcs, the world's greatest astronaut Roy is sent to Mars with Dr. Faz and psychologist Helena to investigate the cosmic rays coming from the planet. What entails is a space epic of recognizable proportions.

films.title: Screamplay
films.synopsis: A talented writer, Edgar Allen, arrives in Hollywood with big dreams but is quickly pulled into a world of madness and depravity. A detective investigating a series of murders discovers that they are similar to the murders that occur in the new script by Edgar. Who will survive and what parts will be left for them?

films.title: Sick
films.synopsis: Sixteen-year-old Maks is sent to the countryside to care for his ailing grandmother. What was once a childhood haven now feels dark and alien. His beloved grandma no longer recognizes him, and his older sister Emma—shaken by a ruined tennis career—seeks comfort in drugs and detachment.

films.title: The Spiral
films.synopsis: On a stormy night in Rome, Anna arrives at her daughter Alice’s apartment with a devastating confession: their entire family history is built on a lie. Twenty years earlier, after a horrific accident that nearly cost Alice her leg, Anna claims she made a pact with a mysterious Stranger to save her. But the miracle came at a price. What she believed was a single desperate bargain has in fact unleashed a spiraling chain reaction — a domino effect of increasingly dark events that have haunted their lives ever since. Now, the Stranger has come to collect. And Anna is convinced that only Alice can break the spiral and set things right. But at what cost?

films.title: The Squirrel
films.synopsis: Pasi, a lonely but kind-hearted designer of artificial animals, lives in a world where nature is just a memory and human well-being is organized with perhaps too much care. One day, Pasi accidentally finds the world's last living squirrel and meets Emilia, an official who enforces the rules of well-being. Pasi decides to defy society's rules and help the squirrel, but something unexpected happens—the squirrel becomes depressed and Pasi falls in love.

films.title: The Swallow
films.synopsis: Ziggy and her four friends journey out on a camping trip to a picturesque remote forest. But trespassing into an off-limits area, they awaken an uncanny terror in the woods... and a ravenous hunger from within the Earth. Soon, the ground itself is trying to swallow anything and anyone it comes into contact with and Ziggy and her friends have nowhere to run as every trembling step they take could be their last.

films.title: Too Many Beasts
films.synopsis: In the French countryside, wild boars ravaging crops spark an open war between farmers and members of a gentlemen’s hunting club, who feed the game between hunts. Brun, a bankrupt farmer, struggles to keep his farm afloat. When the club’s president pushes him to his limits, Brun shoots him and disappears. A year later, Fulda, a volatile police officer just transferred to the region, leads the investigation. Still struggling after a recent breakup, and as wild boars proliferate across the region, he is pushed to the brink of sanity.

films.title: Upiro
films.synopsis: Spain, 1755. Ana is sent to a cloistered monastery where several nuns are afflicted by a mysterious  disease. With the help of an unorthodox priest, the young novice uncovers an ancient legend and  malevolent force: a bloodthirsty upiro.

films.title: Ürei
films.synopsis: When a young girl is left with her aging grandmother in rural Kazakhstan, an ordinary act of familial care quickly turns into an unsettling descent into the unknown where loss can take monstrous forms.

films.title: Vertiginous
films.synopsis: Jacques goes to his friend Bruno's house to tell him some big news: the entire human race is living in a simulation...

films.title: Victorian Psycho
films.synopsis: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

films.title: Welcome to Dolly's House
films.synopsis: A young YouTuber, Princess Maria, is determined to reveal the enigmatic secrets of Madame Dolly, a sorceress who can turn lifeless dolls into human beings. But as Princess Maria delves deeper, suppressed and painful memories resurface within her…

films.title: What Happened to Doris?
films.synopsis: In 1974 LA suburbs, a single mom faces violent attacks by an invisible entity. When no one believes her, she seeks help from paranormal investigators, sparking a notorious documented supernatural case.

films.title: Wild Horse Nine
films.synopsis: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

films.title: Fantastic Shorts
films.synopsis: The “something for everyone” block, themed on nothing being what it seems. Nine shorts: Dead Angle (Goya-winning revenge thriller) · Fester (Canadian dark comedy, toilet-based teleportation) · Gossamer (a singer's irrevocable metamorphosis after biotech restores her voice — Cronenbergian sci-fi merged with a live prog-metal performance, music by Rolo Tomassi) · Is This Desire? (Filipino gothic riff on Henry James) · Jimmy's Custom Coffin (doc: a man planning his own funeral) · Richard Goes on a Date (awkward comedy, telekinesis) · Scraps (masked Christmas-begging tradition turns unsettling) · Spiders on My Lashline (phantasmagoric, genderqueer pole dancer) · The Waddles (absurdist comedy into cosmic horror).

films.title: Drawn & Quartered
films.synopsis: The annual animation block, across stop-motion, hand-drawn and experimental technique. Nine shorts: Eight Uncomfortable Robots (a product catalogue of robots with existential afflictions) · Insecticide · The Magician (spider-like magicians who kidnap babies) · Penguin (Kaspar Jancis) · Pre-Parenting (stop-motion: glasses show expectant parents their child's future life) · Shape of Your Heart (Leonid Shmelkov — Earth after alien intervention) · Starlit (day-glo intergalactic romance) · Visit into Irradiated Land (tours of a nuclear zone, animated with earth on backlit glass so the medium mimics radiation breakdown — Cannes Critics' Week 2026) · Wolpie of the Woods (stop-motion fable).

films.title: BURNT ENDominations
films.synopsis: The Burnt Ends animation block — the festival's own description promises “a midnight mass from the forbidden side of the cartoon dial.” Six shorts: Demoni Ferox: Night People Stole My Baby (5 min, surreal nightmares and the Night People) · I Have A (5 min, Rory Waudby-Tolley — a man lists the things he has) · Mother Earth (17 min, Jimmy ScreamerClauz — aliens weaponise human anger until mankind destroys itself, then discover the one thing they cannot manufacture) · Showgirls — The Da Da Edit (2 min, a lesbian rewrite of an already lesbian film, rotoscoped with reverence) · Timecrow & Friends in: Psycho Psalms (15 min, forgotten 1940s D-list cartoon misfits pulled through a portal into the internet age) · Tom Thumb (26 min, Russian — Tom is chased through a Small World that turns out to fit inside the belly of a mantis he is watching through green glass).

films.title: Shorts With Legs
films.synopsis: The WTF block — “unorthodox birthings, forbidden desires, anthropomorphized bodily fluids.” Nine shorts from six countries: Blessing · Dog Mom (a woman claims to have given live birth to her dog) · EE (erotic thriller about a collectible anime figurine, shot on MiniDV) · A Lobster Named Desire (humanoid crustaceans and intravaginal punk musical numbers) · The Old Lady and the Eternity (an 86-year-old refuses to have her consciousness uploaded; archival footage of the director's own grandmother plus generative AI) · Orla (musical fairytale — a banished maiden and the guardian of the forest) · A Pint of Bitter (a pub pint becomes a galactic nightmare) · Sinkpisser · Stain (a bed stain gives romantic advice).

films.title: Short Fuse
films.synopsis: The signature horror shorts block. Nine shorts: Bagman (creepypasta techno-chiller) · Dëmm (Senegalese folk horror — grief as primeval terror) · Gigit (Malaysian Pontianak folklore; a girl at war with her brother finds a kindred spirit in a vengeful female ghost) · The Haunting of Play House (Chris McInroy of Chäir and Guts — a priest exorcises a demonic playhouse) · It Helps · Scissors (a violent man walks into a den of queer baddies) · Stretcher (fixed-camera French neck-injury shocker) · Transference (Austin-made hypnotherapy creeper) · Vape Glow (sleazy found-footage POV) · Zippy's House.

films.title: Visions Of/From South Africa
films.synopsis: The fourth annual curated sidebar, in partnership with Durban International Film Festival — five South African shorts on identity and self-determination. Being You (an Oscar-winning screenwriter confronts her younger self) · B(l)ind the Sacrifice (Nakhane — a spiritual leader and a rebellious son) · Fleas (two Zimbabwean boys in a South African township; a night journey for water) · The House That Never Sleeps (a reclusive author and bookbinder guarding secrets) · Swim Hard (a swim coach whose event allows no water).

films.title: Secret Screening #1
films.synopsis: Title withheld until the lights go down. Historically a studio genre title opening within six to twelve weeks — this year's plausible candidates are Other Mommy, Clayface and Godzilla Minus Zero.

films.title: Secret Screening #2
films.synopsis: The second undisclosed title, Monday evening.

films.title: Primetime
films.synopsis: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.
